modules.title: Introduction to Complex Numbers
modules.html:
Modulus, argument and operations with complex numbers. This section covers introduction to complex numbers.

Key points

  • Find the value of $i^2$ in complex numbers. — -1.
  • Find the modulus of the complex number $$z = 3 - 4i$$. — $$5$$.
  • The binary operation $$*$$ is defined on the set of real numbers by $$a * b = a + b - ab$$. Find the identity element. — $$0$$.
  • Find the variance of the numbers: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. — $$8$$.
  • Calculate the standard deviation of numbers: 2, 3, 5, 6, 9. — $$2.45$$.

Worked examples

Q: Find the value of $i^2$ in complex numbers.
A: -1 — Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: -1.

Q: Find the modulus of the complex number $$z = 3 - 4i$$.
A: $$5$$ — Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: $$5$$.
